name: creator-generalist
description: creator-generalist: AI agent skills to be professional at 2D and 3D, and to make playable games

plugins.name: 3d-generalist
plugins.description: Full-pipeline 3D generalist studio for content creators: kitbashed scans, rigged characters, character modeling in any style, Blender, three.js and game engine steps, perspective cutaways, expressive acting, camera/lighting and anti-slop QA gates

plugins.name: 2d-generalist
plugins.description: 2D and 2.5D editorial motion graphics in the Vox, Johnny Harris and WSJ explainer look: footage-led Vox look, flat paper cards, print-bordered real photos, highlighters, maps, charts and true-scale timelines, with torn paper, halftone and grain as opt-in stylised looks, across Blender, DaVinci Resolve Fusion, Remotion and FFmpeg.

plugins.name: game-generalist
plugins.description: Playable-game studio for creators: a one-sentence promise becomes a playable greybox you try, a locked look, a built original game and a measured playtest report, on web (three.js, Phaser, canvas), Godot, Unity or Unreal, with scripted bots and gates for errors, win and lose paths, restart, determinism, frame time and softlocks.

plugins.name: watch-video
plugins.description: Watch a video or a whole tutorial channel like a viewer: frames, cuts, sound timeline, transcripts in many languages, tone of voice. Learn a video into a remake recipe, or a channel into a skill with a required verify pass.

plugins.name: design-sound
plugins.description: Sound design for videos, games and reels: a sound library searched by meaning, web and ElevenLabs fetching, foley generated from a silent film with a local video-to-audio model, music fitted to the cut, and a mix to platform loudness checked for sync, masking and phone audibility.
